comment: Entry-trigger config for scripts/watchlist_monitor.py. Routes identify the venue for a fresh agent review: 'polyclaude' uses project-accessible assets and 'ibkr_surface' goes to the operator's personal brokerage. The monitor does not submit trades; a price or event trigger is an observation, not automatic entry authority. Project positions must fit a less-than-one-year horizon and all current evidence, funding, fee, liquidity and execution checks. Multi-year theses remain brokerage-side research.
